title: Private Peggy’s Cove Tour from Halifax
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience one of Nova Scotia’s most iconic destinations on this relaxed and scenic tour to Peggy’s Cove. Guests will enjoy breathtaking coastal views, charming fishing villages, and rich local history along the way. This tour offers a perfect balance of natural beauty and cultural insight, making it an ideal introduction to the Halifax region. Designed for comfort and flexibility, it is suitable for all traveler's, including seniors.
Scenic Peggy’s Cove tour with local history from Halifax.
